method_limitations: TC tracks from MIT model (single GCM downscaling, MPI-ESM1-2-HR) - no multi-model ensemble
Mangrove data is 10% sample - spatial resolution limited
No future TC projections available in data - only historical baseline used
SLR rates are regional (not local) - local subsidence/uplift not captured
Equal weighting of TC and SLR in composite index is a simplifying assumption
